svg.title: C15-M08-F2: Decryption checks in order
svg.desc: A chain of checks on length, format, parameter bounds, key derivation and authenticated decryption, ending in an atomic write, with any failure producing a generic error and no partial file.
svg.text: length >= 36+16? -> magic/kdf ok? -> parameters in bounds? -> derive key
-> AEAD decrypt with header AAD -> OK: write via temp file + replace
any failure: generic error, exit 1 (auth) or 2 (input), no partial output
Figure C15-M08-F2. Cheap structural checks precede expensive derivation; authentication
